text: Practice how to distinguish a session locator from bidding authority.
A new representative needs new valid authority, not another copy of the room code.
Example: A team bidder disconnects during an auction. Another member still sees the room code.

items: Use the room code to take over bidding The room code alone does not grant bidding rights.
Request an authorized bidder transfer A valid transfer can revoke the old bidder and assign a current lease.

text: The new representative has an active bidder lease. An old tab sends a delayed offer.

items: Reject the stale offer on the server The old lease epoch no longer carries bidding authority.
Let the old tab bid because it was once valid A previous lease must not regain permission after revocation.

text: The transfer preserves one valid bidding representative.
Check authority on every state-changing action.
The chosen action is not an authorized equipment recovery procedure.
Use a scoped transfer or facilitator equipment recovery path.
Explicit role transfer keeps one active bidder and protects the room.
